survey: A single blue plastic sports bottle floating against a yellow sunburst, tilted about 25° to the right. Body: a translucent, waisted cylinder with a curved grip groove across the middle and a water line near the shoulder. Its axis runs from lower left to upper right, and the bottle is seen slightly from above. Bottom: the base rim curves downward as a shallow ellipse, which fits a cylinder seen from above. The inner base disc shows through the plastic. Shoulder and cap: the neck rings and screw cap are ellipses of about the same narrowness as the base. Their top faces are visible, so they agree with the same high viewpoint and sit square to the body's tilted axis. The spout sits on top of the cap, centered and aligned with the axis. Its top is also a slightly open ellipse. Carry loop: a flat ring that sticks out sideways from the cap. It lies roughly in the picture plane, so it reads almost as a circle. That fits because the ring's plane contains the bottle's axis. The grip groove and water line wrap around the body as curves that bow the same way as the rim ellipses. There is no ground plane, so there is no contact point to check.
